title: Ore Pouch
description: A lightweight Quality of Life pouch that instantly smelts ores in your inventory using coal. Save your time while mining!
body:
# 🎒 Ore Pouch

**Tired of placing dozens of furnaces and waiting for your iron and gold to smelt after a long mining session?** **Ore Pouch** is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly Quality of Life (QoL) mod that adds a portable smelting bag to your game. It allows you to instantly process raw ores into ingots directly in your inventory, keeping your mining trips efficient and fast.

## ✨ Features
* **Instant Smelting:** Place raw ores and coal inside the pouch. It instantly smelts the ores at a perfectly balanced **1:1 ratio** (1 Coal = 1 Smelted Item).
* **Smart Storage:** The pouch saves your items inside. If you close the GUI, your ores and ingots won't drop on the ground.
* **Intuitive GUI:** Uses a familiar, vanilla-style interface. 
* **Shift-Click Support:** Fully supports smart Shift-clicking for rapid item transfer between your inventory and the pouch.
* **Early-Game Friendly:** The crafting recipe is simple and accessible from the first days of your survival.

## 🛠️ Crafting Recipe
To craft the Ore Pouch, you will need:
* 3x Leather
* 2x String
* 1x Coal (in the center)

*(Fully compatible with **JEI / REI** for easy recipe viewing).*

## ⚙️ Modpack Makers
You are completely free to use **Ore Pouch** in any of your modpacks! It is highly optimized, causes no lag, and is a perfect addition to any RPG, Vanilla+, or Tech modpack.
